quote: Service environments have been removed. Wrangler now always deploys each environment as its own Worker named `<name>-<environment>`
answer: Wrangler no longer supports service environments: the `legacy_env` field and `--legacy-env` flag are gone (the field now raises an error) and every environment deploys as its own Worker named <name>-<environment>.
stale: You can set `legacy_env = false` in wrangler.toml to use service environments, where all environments belong to one Worker.

quote: To keep Node.js compatibility switched off on a newer compatibility date, specify both `no_nodejs_compat` and `no_nodejs_compat_v2`, since each flag has its own default.
answer: To turn Node.js compatibility off on a compatibility date of 2026-08-04 or later, set both `no_nodejs_compat` and `no_nodejs_compat_v2` flags.
stale: Node.js compatibility is off unless you add `nodejs_compat`, so you simply leave the flag out to disable it.

quote: These now resolve to the latest compatibility date supported by this version of Wrangler, which is the release date of the `workerd` it ships with.
answer: `wrangler deploy --latest` and `wrangler versions upload --latest` set the compatibility date to the newest date the bundled workerd supports (its release date).
stale: `wrangler deploy --latest` sets the compatibility date to today's date.

quote: Wrangler now disables telemetry when `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` is set, regardless of other telemetry settings.
answer: Setting `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` turns off Wrangler telemetry, regardless of other telemetry settings.
stale: Wrangler ignores DO_NOT_TRACK; you must run `wrangler telemetry disable` or set WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false.

quote: You can now create a D1 database in the US jurisdiction with `wrangler d1 create <name> --jurisdiction us`.
answer: `wrangler d1 create <name> --jurisdiction us` creates a D1 database in the US jurisdiction.
stale: D1 jurisdictions are limited to eu and fedramp; there is no US jurisdiction option.

quote: `wrangler dev` and the Vite plugin now capture request traces and console logs into the Local Explorer's Observability tab out of the box
answer: `wrangler dev` captures local traces and console logs into the Local Explorer Observability tab by default; set `X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=false` to opt out.
stale: Local observability capture in wrangler dev is opt-in behind `X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=true` (or does not exist).

quote: The compressed script size limits (3 MiB free / 10 MiB paid) have been removed server-side in favor of a single 64 MiB uncompressed limit.
answer: Workers have a single 64 MiB uncompressed script size limit, and Wrangler's size warnings compare the uncompressed bundle against it.
stale: Worker scripts are limited to 3 MiB (free) or 10 MiB (paid) after gzip compression.

quote: Use `--durable-objects-code-update-mode immediate` with `wrangler deploy`, `wrangler versions deploy`, and `wrangler rollback` to update code without waiting for active instances to hibernate.
answer: Deploys can choose a Durable Objects code update strategy (`--durable-objects-code-update-mode immediate` or `deferred <delay>`, or `durable_objects.code_update_strategy`); unset, it is deferred with a 5-minute maximum delay.
stale: There is no option to control when running Durable Object instances pick up new code after a deploy.

quote: Basin SQL is now available under `wrangler basin sql`, Basin Catalog operations are available under `wrangler basin catalog`, and Pipelines operations are available under `wrangler basin pipelines`.
answer: R2 SQL, R2 Data Catalog and Pipelines commands now live under `wrangler basin sql`, `wrangler basin catalog` and `wrangler basin pipelines` and are stable; the old paths remain only as hidden aliases.
stale: Use `wrangler r2 sql`, `wrangler r2 bucket catalog` and `wrangler pipelines` (beta) for these features.

quote: Graduate `wrangler check startup` from alpha and show bundle size and a local timing summary
answer: `wrangler check startup` is no longer alpha and reports bundle sizes plus a local timing summary.
stale: `wrangler check startup` is an alpha command that only writes a CPU profile.

quote: Add support for configuring a per-workflow max concurrency limit via `workflows[].concurrency.limit` in your Wrangler config.
answer: A Workflow's maximum number of concurrently running instances can be set with `workflows[].concurrency.limit` in the Wrangler config.
stale: Workflows have no per-workflow concurrency setting in Wrangler config; only account limits apply.

quote: You can now configure a Worker to receive raw socket connections during `wrangler dev`, delivered directly to the Worker's `connect(socket, env, ctx)` handler:
answer: A `connect` trigger (e.g. `"connect": [{ "protocol": "tcp", "port": 5432 }]`) lets a Worker receive raw TCP connections in its `connect(socket, env, ctx)` handler during wrangler dev (experimental flag required).
stale: Workers can only receive HTTP requests; inbound raw TCP sockets are not possible.

quote: Miniflare v5 moved its internal local testing endpoints to `/cdn-cgi/local/*`
answer: Local testing endpoints moved to `/cdn-cgi/local/*` in Miniflare v5; wrangler dev rewrites the old `/cdn-cgi/*` paths so they still work.
stale: Local test endpoints such as the scheduled handler trigger live directly under `/cdn-cgi/` (e.g. /cdn-cgi/handler/scheduled).

quote: Drop the "Experimental:" prefix from the resource provisioning header now that automatic provisioning is generally available.
answer: Automatic resource provisioning on `wrangler deploy` is generally available (and now also covers Queue, Dispatch Namespace and Flagship bindings).
stale: Automatic provisioning of bindings on deploy is an experimental feature.

quote: Set a secret's value to `null` in JSON input to remove it from the new Worker version.
answer: `wrangler versions secret bulk` deletes a secret when its value is `null` in the JSON input.
stale: `wrangler versions secret bulk` can only create or update secrets; delete them one by one with `wrangler versions secret delete`.

quote: Breaking: remove the first pass of `agents/channels` and move Channels to `agents/experimental/channels`.
answer: The `agents/channels` entry point is gone; Channels now lives under `agents/experimental/channels` (Slack, Telegram and Email under its subpaths) and is experimental.
stale: Import Channels (ChannelHost, Slack/Telegram/Email adapters) from `agents/channels`.

quote: Add `npx agents tui <url>`, a terminal client for a conversation's Web Channel.
answer: `npx agents tui <url>` opens a terminal client for an agent conversation's Web Channel.
stale: The agents package has no terminal client command.

quote: address Agents by name because raw IDs from `newUniqueId()` and `idFromString()` now fail their first async RPC
answer: Native RPC to async Agent/Think methods first runs lifecycle initialization, so Agents must be addressed by name; stubs from `newUniqueId()` or `idFromString()` fail their first async RPC.
stale: You can get an Agent stub from any Durable Object ID, including `newUniqueId()` or `idFromString()`, and call its methods over RPC.

quote: Queued callbacks run from the alarm loop in a fresh invocation, so they no longer see the enqueuing request's `connection` or `request` through `getCurrentAgent()`
answer: Callbacks queued with `this.queue()` run later from the alarm loop, so `getCurrentAgent()` inside them returns the agent but not the original `connection` or `request`.
stale: Queued callbacks run in the same context and can read the enqueuing request's connection and request via getCurrentAgent().

quote: `useAgent({ transport })` and `AgentClient({ transport })` pick the wire.
answer: `useAgent` and `AgentClient` take a `transport` option: "cf-websocket" (default, hibernating) or "capnweb" for a Cap'n Web session with native RPC stubs.
stale: useAgent/AgentClient always use the JSON-over-WebSocket protocol; there is no transport choice.

quote: `subAgent()` / `abortSubAgent()` / `deleteSubAgent()` / `hasSubAgent()` / `listSubAgents()` are unchanged in behavior and now delegate to the same capability — `@deprecated` in place, not removed.
answer: `subAgent()` and its siblings are deprecated in favor of `this.dynamicAgents.{get,abort,delete,has,list}`, and facets are positioned as an isolation primitive rather than the way to model many chat sessions.
stale: Use `this.subAgent()` (the recommended API) to create sub-agents, e.g. one per chat session.

quote: `Agent` now directly extends Cloudflare's `DurableObject` and composes the same lifecycle used by standalone objects
answer: `Agent` extends Cloudflare's `DurableObject` directly, with the needed PartyServer runtime vendored into `agents/lifecycle`.
stale: `Agent` extends PartyServer's `Server` class.

quote: `useAgentChat` now coalesces those updates every 50ms
answer: `useAgentChat` throttles UI updates to every 50ms by default; pass `throttle: false` to render every chunk or a number to change the interval.
stale: useAgentChat re-renders on every streamed chunk unless you set `experimental_throttle`.

quote: Scheduled callbacks now receive the documented parsed `Schedule` object as their second argument (previously the raw storage row, whose `payload` was an unparsed JSON string).
answer: A scheduled callback's second argument is the parsed `Schedule` object.
stale: A scheduled callback's second argument is the raw storage row with `payload` as a JSON string.

quote: Add `Scheduler`, a reusable Lifecycle capability for persistent delayed, dated, cron, and interval callbacks, under `agents/schedules`.
answer: `agents/schedules` exports `Scheduler`, a Lifecycle capability for delayed, dated, cron and interval callbacks that any Durable Object can use, with typed `set()`/`every()`.
stale: Scheduling is only available as `this.schedule()` on an Agent subclass.

quote: `MCPClientManagerOptions.storage` is removed
answer: `MCPClientManager` gets storage from the Lifecycle it is installed on; the `storage` option was removed, so standalone construction with explicit DurableObjectStorage is not supported.
stale: Construct `MCPClientManager` with a `storage` option pointing at DurableObjectStorage.

quote: Use `wrapAISDK()` as the single AI SDK v6 and v7 tracing integration, removing the separate `createAISDKTelemetry()` callback adapter
answer: `wrapAISDK()` from `agents/observability/ai` is the only AI SDK tracing integration for both v6 and v7; `createAISDKTelemetry()` was removed.
stale: Use `createAISDKTelemetry()` for AI SDK v7 tracing and `wrapAISDK` for v6.

quote: Add MCP SDK v2 support to `createMcpHandler`.
answer: `createMcpHandler` accepts a factory returning a v2 `McpServer`/`Server` from `@modelcontextprotocol/server` and serves stateless MCP with legacy compatibility; `createLegacyMcpHandler` remains for SDK v1 servers.
stale: `createMcpHandler` takes an `McpServer` from `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` (v1).

quote: It probes for stateless MCP with `server/discover`, then falls back to the legacy `initialize` handshake on the same connection when needed.
answer: The Agents MCP client first probes with `server/discover` (stateless MCP, 2026-07-28) and falls back to the `initialize` handshake for older servers.
stale: The MCP client always starts with an `initialize` handshake.

quote: The `ai` peer range is `ai@^6 || ^7` (and `@ai-sdk/react` is `@^3 || ^4`) across
answer: agents (and ai-chat, codemode, think) support both AI SDK v6 and v7 (`ai@^6 || ^7`).
stale: agents requires AI SDK v5 (or v6 only).

quote: Fail the test when an asynchronous assertion is not awaited
answer: A test fails if an async assertion (such as expect(...).resolves) is not awaited.
stale: An un-awaited async assertion only prints a warning.

quote: Don't lookup config file from ancestor directories
answer: Vitest 5 no longer searches parent directories for a config file.
stale: Vitest walks up ancestor directories to find vitest.config / vite.config.

quote: Inline @vitest/runner package, do not publish it anymore
answer: @vitest/runner is bundled into vitest and no longer published separately.
stale: Import runner APIs from the separate @vitest/runner package.

quote: Remove webdriverio package
answer: The WebdriverIO browser provider package was removed in Vitest 5.
stale: Use @vitest/browser-webdriverio as a browser mode provider.

quote: toHaveTextContent is strict, add toMatchTextContent as alternative
answer: toHaveTextContent now matches strictly; use the new toMatchTextContent for partial matching.
stale: toHaveTextContent('foo') passes when the text merely contains 'foo'.

quote: blob reporter and --merge-reports default to .vitest/blob/
answer: The blob reporter and --merge-reports use .vitest/blob/ by default.
stale: Blob reports go to .vitest-reports/ by default.

quote: Enable locators.exact by default
answer: In browser mode, locators match text exactly by default (locators.exact is true).
stale: Browser mode locators such as getByText match substrings by default.

quote: Use > as separator in -t
answer: In `-t` / testNamePattern, nested suite and test names are joined with `>`.
stale: Suite and test names in the -t full name are joined with a space.

quote: Inline projects extend the root config by default
answer: Inline projects in `test.projects` inherit the root config by default.
stale: Inline projects do not inherit the root config unless you set `extends: true`.

quote: Fail expect.poll when function didn't resolve in time
answer: expect.poll fails when the polled function does not resolve within the timeout.
stale: expect.poll keeps waiting on a function that never resolves.

quote: Throw an error if hoistable methods are outside the top level scope
answer: Calling hoisted methods such as vi.mock outside the module's top level now throws an error.
stale: vi.mock inside a function or block only warns and is still hoisted.

quote: Create vi.when()
answer: Vitest 5 adds `vi.when()` for argument-conditional mock behavior.
stale: Vitest has no vi.when(); use mockImplementation with manual argument checks.

quote: Add --repeats CLI option
answer: The `--repeats` CLI option reruns tests a given number of times.
stale: Repeats can only be set per test via the `repeats` test option.

quote: Support -p shorthand for --project
answer: `-p` is shorthand for `--project`.
stale: There is no short alias for --project.

quote: Parse files statically in vitest list by default
answer: `vitest list` collects tests by static parsing by default instead of running files.
stale: `vitest list` executes test files to collect test names.
